quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #20
										  					
  

37 Questions • Passing Score 32

questions.question: When passing another vehicle on a two-lane road with traffic in opposite directions, what should you do?

options.text: Return to your lane when there is enough space between you and the vehicle you passed.
Stay in the left lane if you plan to turn left.
Return to the right side of the road immediately.

questions.correctAnswerText: Return to your lane when there is enough space between you and the vehicle you passed.
questions.explanation: When passing on a two-lane road, return to the right lane when there is enough space between you and the vehicle you passed.

questions.question: When turning left from a multi-lane, one-way street or highway, which lane should you start from?
questions.explanation: To turn left from a multi-lane street or highway, you must start from the left lane.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a flashing yellow arrow on a traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
You may turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
You have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
questions.explanation: A flashing yellow arrow means you can turn left in that direction. However, oncoming traffic has a green light, so you must yield to them and to pedestrians.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady yellow arrow on a traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into a lane in the direction of the arrow.
Slow down and stop if you can do so safely.
You may turn left after letting oncoming traffic and pedestrians pass.
You have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop for you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means a red arrow is coming next. Slow down and stop unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: What does a solid yellow arrow mean on a traffic signal?

options.text: It is never used on a traffic signal.
It means the same thing as a yellow circular traffic light.
Drivers may turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
A green arrow is about to appear.

questions.correctAnswerText: It means the same thing as a yellow circular traffic light.
questions.explanation: A solid yellow arrow has the same meaning as a yellow traffic light. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed from the lane next to the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the lane next to the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane next to the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line means you can pass if you are in the lane next to the broken line.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entry from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way and you cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What is the speed limit on interstates unless a different speed is posted?
questions.explanation: The speed limit on interstates is 70 mph unless a different speed limit is posted. Always follow posted speed limits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep hill ahead.

questions.question: What is a "No zone"?

options.text: An area where you cannot pass other vehicles
The blind spot of a large vehicle

questions.correctAnswerText: The blind spot of a large vehicle
questions.explanation: A "No zone" is the blind spot around trucks and large vehicles. Avoid staying in these areas when driving near large vehicles.

questions.question: You see a flashing yellow light at an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Stop and wait for the light to change
Make a U-turn because the intersection is closed
Get ready to stop because the light is about to turn red

questions.explanation: A flashing yellow light means go slowly and look both ways before entering the intersection.

questions.question: When driving in fog, which lights should you use?

options.text: It does not matter which lights you use

questions.explanation: Use low beam headlights when driving in fog, rain, or snow.

questions.question: When must you pull over for an emergency vehicle?

options.text: No matter what direction it is coming from
Only if it is behind you
Only if it is coming toward you

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter what direction it is coming from
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right edge of the road and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is behind you or coming toward you.

questions.question: If you need to slow down on a slippery road, what should you do first?

options.text: Take your foot off the gas pedal

questions.correctAnswerText: Take your foot off the gas pedal
questions.explanation: First, take your foot off the gas pedal. If you need to slow down more, gently and slowly press your brake pedal.

questions.question: Guide signs are ____ signs that tell drivers directions and distances.
questions.explanation: Guide signs have a green background. They show directions and distances to help you find your destination.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you can turn left on a green light, but you must yield to oncoming traffic and wait until it is safe.

questions.question: A school bus is stopped on the opposite side of a divided highway. What should you do?

options.text: You must stop until the bus starts moving
You must stop until the stop arm goes up
You must stop until the lights stop flashing

questions.explanation: If the highway is divided by a median, you can keep driving past a stopped school bus on the other side. You only have to stop if the highway is not divided.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left
The road turns sharply left, then right

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: Which traffic light means: stop completely, let traffic and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe?
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means the same as a stop sign. You must stop, yield to traffic and pedestrians, and go when it is safe.

questions.question: When changing lanes, you should:

options.text: Signal as you move into the next lane.
Signal at least 500 feet before changing lanes on residential streets.

questions.explanation: Other vehicles and motorcycles can hide in your blind spot. Look over your shoulder before you change lanes. Signal 100 feet before changing lanes on residential streets. Signal 5 seconds before changing lanes on a freeway.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic is entering from the right.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: Blood alcohol content (BAC) depends on each of the following, except:

options.text: How much time passes between drinks.

questions.explanation: BAC depends on how much you drink, the time between drinks, and your weight. Physical fitness does not affect BAC.

questions.question: The driver's left arm and hand are extended upward. This hand signal means the driver plans to:
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm points up, they are signaling a right turn. Adjust your driving if you see this hand signal.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road will curve right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question:
About 38 percent of all traffic fatalities involve which of the following?
    I. Alcohol
    II. More than one car.
questions.explanation: About 38 percent of all traffic fatalities involve alcohol.

questions.question: You are driving in the left lane and want to move into the right lane. You should:

options.text: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your left shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and look over both shoulders for other vehicles before changing lanes.
Check your mirrors, signal, and change lanes.

questions.correctAnswerText: Check your mirrors, signal, and look over your right shoulder for other vehicles before changing lanes.
questions.explanation: Check your mirrors and turn on your signal before changing lanes. Look over your shoulder in the direction you are moving to check your blind spot.

questions.question:
Which of the following happen under the point system?
    I. A warning letter is sent when you get four points within three years.
    II. If you get 12 points within three years, you may lose your license.
questions.explanation: Getting 7 points may require you to attend a driver improvement class. Getting 12 points in 3 years may result in license suspension. Getting 8 points within 3 years of reinstatement may result in a second suspension.

questions.question: Which is not a factor in determining stopping distance?
questions.explanation: Stopping distance depends on perception time, reaction distance, and braking distance. These change based on your speed and road conditions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: When parking uphill on a hill with a curb, which way should you turn your front wheels?

options.text: Turn your front wheels sharply toward the curb.
Turn your front wheels slightly to the right.
Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb.
questions.explanation: Turn your front wheels sharply away from the curb when parking uphill. This prevents your car from rolling into traffic if the brakes fail. On streets without a curb, turn your wheels toward the edge of the road.

questions.question: What do round signs mean?
questions.explanation: Round signs warn you of an upcoming railroad crossing. Be extra careful when you see this sign and approach the crossing slowly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming. Be ready to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow backgrounds and black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that pedestrians may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: When can you use your horn?

options.text: When you have to stop quickly.
When you are passing another car.
When you have lost control of your car.
When you are passing a bicyclist.

questions.correctAnswerText: When you have lost control of your car.
questions.explanation: Use your horn if you lose control of your vehicle. Sound it to warn other drivers of the danger.
